sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation permits a self-referential infinite list, and only the demanded head is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: The endless can be real without being exhausted; a single present moment is enough to inhabit it.
sketches.draft:
forever :: [()]
forever = () : forever
now :: ()
now = head forever

sketches.mechanism: A range-constrained subtype enforces its bounds, so an out-of-range assignment is rejected by the language's constraint checks.
sketches.resonance: A world defined to hold only one cannot make room for a second without breaking its own law.

sketches.mechanism: The missing value NA propagates through equality and cannot be used as a definite condition in if.
sketches.resonance: What is unknown cannot even confirm itself, and action stalls before uncertainty.
sketches.draft:
memory <- NA
answer <- memory == memory
if (answer) 1
